review.scope: Read-only review of plans projection capacity; no compiler, Store, query, crypto or other table-budget change.

state_layout.measurement_source: Root-supplied qualified baseline State measurement; delta independently derived from two resident Tables values in Live.
state_layout.notes: Work.plans remains a borrowed string descriptor. Offsets after enlarged Tables within Live change. State's sizeof-based layout fingerprint changes; headers, native adapters and Wasm must be regenerated together.

strict_bounds.finding: json_raw refuses a negative offset or an append beyond the destination count with -1, preserving failure through a chained writer.
write_plans marks Tables.complete=false on plans or info output exhaustion, and records zero length for the failed output. The unchanged 16KiB info cap can still independently refuse a candidate.
write_tables sets complete at entry and does not reset it after write_plans fails.
live_prepare refuses an incomplete candidate instead of marking it ready.

live_apply refuses incomplete or oversized item candidates before advancing the fold counter or replacing any displayed table. Refusal deliberately sets OFFLINE/incomplete=5 and clears dirty, while retaining the five displayed tables and fold counter.

findings: Existing plan_line/plan_step parsing and normalization are unchanged.
Projection retains the existing per-task 24-step limit; it does not claim unbounded plan text.
Working tasks' plans are emitted first, then plans on remaining task roots without filtering closed/resolved tasks.
Latest-plan selection, event history, status, rank and author rules remain unchanged.
The larger output array does not rewrite or discard original signed event bytes.

ui_consumption.finding: Consumers iterate the admitted plans string count and draw a bounded visible window; Work does not add another fixed-size plans copy. Existing parser/field bounds continue to apply.

qualification_limits: This is an output-capacity and prior-view-atomicity review, not whole-app interpreter authority qualification.
Book agent owns independent exact 65536/65537-byte native fixtures and actual signed public capture parity; this reviewer did not duplicate those passing gates.

Cold page initialization uses the same 64MiB browser cap. Development hot reload may need a full page reload: host.js:292-305 allocates a fresh whole arena above existing memory when State grows, so retaining the previous large arena can exhaust that cap. No hot-state migration claim is made.
review.review_result: The plans-array-only increase preserves the existing strict output bounds and fail-closed publication model; require exact writer-boundary and cold-page evidence before claiming qualification.

golden_gate.rule: Keep demonstrated baseline failures separate; no golden updates.
